name: League of Women Voters Candidate Forum
agenda_text:
100 E. La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, CA
WHEN ADDRESSING COUNCIL PLEASE COMPLETE A SPEAKER'S CARD BEFORE LEAVING COUNCIL CHAMBERS
AGENDA
LEAGUE OF WOMEN VOTERS CANDIDATE FORUM
Wednesday, September 26, 2018
6:00 p.m.
The purpose of this night is to give candidates an opportunity to address a wide range of issues that affect our community. This evening is not intended to be a debate among the candidates, but rather a forum for the candidates to share their positions on key issues with the public.
______________________________________
Laurie Swindell, CMC, City Clerk
